title: Replace a motor vehicle repairer licence
summary: You can apply for a replacement motor vehicle repairer licence if your original licence has been lost, damaged, or destroyed.
intro: If your motor vehicle repairer licence has been lost, damaged, or destroyed, you can apply for a replacement via email, or in person at a Service NSW Centre.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for Replacement Licence or Certificate'
Details of the licence, including the licence number
Contact details of the licence holder

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and submit it:

more_info.text: To look up your motor vehicle repairer licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.

faqs.q: How can I replace my lost or damaged licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a replacement licence by email or in person at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for a replacement licence?
faqs.a: You need the 'Application for Replacement Licence or Certificate' PDF form, details of the licence (including the licence number), the licence holder's contact details, and your fee payment receipt number.
